# rootshellVNC

The source in this directory comes from [rootshell-vnc at 94a9d12](https://github.com/kitknox/rootshell-vnc/tree/94a9d12ff7936ce90cb8d3b50d7042ba9db3c482). The upstream MIT license is included in this directory and in the app's acknowledgements. The package manifest contains the targets used by the two clients.

The local renderer supports one-byte true-color RFB pixels in Core Graphics snapshots and live display surfaces. The upstream also provides 16-bit and 32-bit rendering.
